evidence: Labeled 'Validation' and alters chainstate verification logic in src/validation.cpp (CVerifyDB::VerifyDB).
rationale: Fixes false database corruption errors and prevented node restarts when startup checks encounter missing block undo data on pruned nodes or AssumeUTXO chainstates. When blocks are refetched without undo data, verification at check level >2 'reports database corruption, preventing the node from restarting', which directly impacts chainstate integrity reporting and node reliability.
